name: What is a drain camera inspection and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is a drain camera inspection and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: A drain camera inspection involves inserting a high-resolution, waterproof camera attached to a flexible rod into your drainpipes. This allows technicians to visually assess the inside of your pipes in real-time on a monitor. The camera helps identify the exact location and cause of blockages, such as tree roots, cracks, corrosion, or misaligned pipes, without needing to excavate. It’s a non-invasive way to diagnose plumbing issues accurately.
acceptedAnswer.description: A drain camera inspection uses a waterproof camera to visually examine the inside of your pipes, identifying blockages or damage. It's a non-invasive way to diagnose plumbing problems.
